quality.review_scope: Main-only source-scoped CdSe core synthesis, direct and stepwise CdS shelling, reported failed controls and post-growth variants, specimen preparation and optical/structural characterization. This is a selected synthesis and figure review, not a complete laboratory SOP or full-paper narrative Reader.
